FROM store_sales 
JOIN (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk 
    FROM household_demographics 
    WHERE hd_dep_count = 0
) AS filtered_hdemo ON ss_hdemo_sk = filtered_hdemo.hd_demo_sk 
JOIN (
    SELECT t_time_sk 
    FROM time_dim 
    WHERE t_hour = 8 AND t_minute >= 30
) AS filtered_time ON ss_sold_time_sk = filtered_time.t_time_sk 
JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk 
WHERE s_store_name = 'ese' 
ORDER BY COUNT(*) 
LIMIT 100
